## Status

This ticket is superseded by the atomic typed-intrinsic cutover in fz-5xp.30. Its valid requirements are now part of that ticket: operator and comparison primitives stop masquerading as extern symbols, carry one exact typed intrinsic identity, and delete every per-door symbol-name interception path.

No implementation from this ticket is to land separately. Consult fz-5xp.30 for the current goal, model, TDD signal, deletion list and ordering. This description replaces the former plan; historical comments are evidence only.
